view.description: The screen (a navigation.place view); absent when the URL is not a dock address.

pointer.description: What the address names inside the screen.

address.description: The full dock address, query included: /dock/project/<id>?viewMode=board.

project.description: The project in scope -- every screen has one.

process.description: The session in scope, when the screen provides one.

entity.description: What is open, when the screen provides one -- what 'this' refers to.

last_shown.description: What the session showed last -- what 'it' / 'again' refer to.

recent.description: The project's most recently used session -- what "resume my last chat" opens.
